section.title: Lantern Market
section.intro: Lay numbered jewel tiles from a looping hotpot belt onto a hex board, serve patrons before they give up, buy stall upgrades and travel five stops to the Grand Bazaar.

perks.window: One more dish at the counter
perks.guard: A 7 gives you 1 gold instead of the raccoon stealing
perks.swapcap: +2 swaps now, hold up to 2 more
perks.joker: Adds 2 jokers to the bag now and at every refill
perks.wok: Melds of 5 or more give +1 prestige
perks.steamer: Districts make 1 extra gem when rolled

recipe.text: Numbered colour tiles, runs and sets, and jokers.
Line up three or more to clear them, chain combos, and use swaps.
The conveyor belt. Dishes you skip come back round, so you can plan ahead.
Patrons with orders and a patience bar. If they wait too long, you lose a lantern.
Tour buses fill with passengers of one colour, one cleared tile at a time.
Hex districts with number chips, a 2d6 roll every turn, a raccoon on 7, 4-for-1 trades and a harbour.
Gems flow in from the districts. Place tiles that match a district's colour and it makes more.
Gem-priced stall cards that make future cards cheaper, plus prestige points.
Bloom: fill a whole district with 1 to 7, each number once.
Cake: fill a whole district with one colour, like finishing a cake slice by slice.
A five-stop food journey that gets harder at every stop.
The prestige jewel at the top colours in facet by facet.
